------
For the Petitioner : Mr. Rohan Mazumdar, Advocate For the State : Mr. Subodh Kumar Dubey,
Addl.P.P ------
Order No.02 Dated- 14.06.2024 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2. Apprehending his arrest in connection with Sonari P.S. Case No. 175 of 2015 corresponding to G.R. No. 3276 of 2015 instituted under Sections 406, 420 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code, the petitioner has moved this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that earlier the prayer of anticipatory bail of the petitioner has been rejected by this Court vide order dated 14.10.2022 passed in A.B.A. No.7665 of 2022 with observation that "he is co-operating with the investigation of the case and there is no reasonable ground to apprehend his arrest in this case."
It is further submitted that after completion of investigation, now charge-sheet has been submitted against the petitioner.
Hence, the petitioner may be extended the privilege of anticipatory bail.

4. Learned Addl.P.P appearing for the State opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner and submits that earlier the prayer of anticipatory bail of the petitioner has been rejected by this Court vide order dated 14.10.2022 passed in A.B.A. No.7665 of 2022 and no fresh ground has been taken by the petitioner in the present application.
Hence, petitioner may not be extended privilege of anticipatory bail.
5. It appears that the investigation has been concluded and during investigation, petitioner has co-operated with the investigation and charge-sheet has been submitted against the petitioner.
Hence, without expressing any view on the merits of the case, this anticipatory bail application is disposed off.
